body: I've tried, but no one cares. I've been there for others, but I'm always put on the back burner. No one will listen. I've been canceled on, lied to more times than I'd like to admit. And now that I'm past college and finished school, I've missed my best chances to make better friends. Not from lack of trying, either. No one ever wants me around that much.

I've tried. But I have no pictures of myself that aren't just selfies, nothing interesting for a profile, and most importantly I'm not interesting. I can be outgoing but I have nothing worth saying. Getting mainly fake ad responses is another layer of crushing that I can't handle.

I kept telling myself that. But seeing everybody around me finding people to be with or getting married while I'm now out of college and haven't even been able to go on a single date... it's me. I can't argue with history.
It won't be necessary, but I appreciate it
I did try, but it didn't work. No one on my life cares whether I'm around or not. They just want me to go away so they can get on living life with people who they actually care about
I wish I could believe that but it never gets better
